title: Build Bundle Executor
description: Consolidated build executor that runs TSC (optional), ESBuild, and minimize-deps in a single step

runTsc.description: Whether to run TypeScript compiler first (required for projects using decorators, like projects with Nest.js). Default: true

tscCwd.description: Working directory for TSC command. Relative to workspace root. Default: {projectRoot}

tscOutputDir.description: Output directory for TSC compilation. Default: 'out-tsc'

mainFile.description: Path to the TypeScript entry file (relative to project root), e.g. src/main.ts. When runTsc is true, the executor uses the compiled .js under tscOutputDir. When runTsc is false, this .ts file is passed to ESBuild directly. Supports {projectRoot} and {workspaceRoot}.

tsConfigPath.description: Path to tsconfig.json file (relative to project root)

esbuildOptions.description: Additional ESBuild options to override defaults

outputDir.description: Output directory for the bundled file and meta.json. Default: 'dist'

outputFile.description: Name of the output bundle file. Default: 'main.js'

generateMinimalDeps.description: Whether to generate minimal package.json using minimize-deps. Default: true

runtimeDeps.description: Additional runtime dependencies to always include in the minimal package.json

assets.description: After the bundle, copy files into outputDir (paths may use {workspaceRoot} and {projectRoot}). A string copies that file or directory into outputDir using its basename; an object globs under input and writes under output (relative to outputDir), preserving relative paths.

output.description: Subdirectory under outputDir to write matched files
